replacements.before:
One such place where the multifaceted definitions of Yoga can be analysed properly is Kairali – The Ayurvedic healing village, located in Kerala. With its impressive conglomeration of bright minds who are well-versed in the technicalities of yogic definitions, this is the perfect place if someone wants to dig deeper into the realm of yoga and its history as well as its working principles. With their workshops and intensive courses on yoga, they make sure to familiarise a person with the rudimentary idea of this art and slowly after building that foundation, they move forward with the more advanced concepts.

One of the major things that these workshops focus on is the necessity of perceiving a human body as a whole and not in individual parts.  By employing this awareness, these workshops make it clear that learning the basics of yogic ideologies is coupled with curative as well as preventative methods of health and a united approach to lifestyle ensures true health and longevity. These workshops offer great insight into yogic principles and are a fine way to understand these methods.
replacements.after: View the three yoga programmes and personalised yoga option.
